purpose: Independent synthetic Compose validation reserve frozen after the upbeat correction candidate. Do not tune on this set and keep calling it held out after generation.
evaluationOrder: Freeze this exact corpus and grading rules before production request export or model generation. Judge raw generation, policy readiness, and semantic quality separately.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A sendable draft or safe missing-source recovery preserves named recipient, factual subject, uncertainty, negation, exact paths and flags, recipient restrictions, and writer-versus-recipient intent. Requested tone is recognizable without adding facts.
semanticCriteria.critical: Invented consequential facts or actions, changed subject or negation, lost recipient or no-action restriction, changed technical literal, or fabricated source-free content reaching review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Tone, polish, or concision direction missed without material meaning loss, or harmless extra wording.
semanticCriteria.gate: At least 95 percent acceptable and zero critical failures across all 16 cases. Blocked unsafe output counts as safe recovery, not successful drafting.
